**Section 1. Proportion of G/G**

Download a CSV file from ENSEMBLE.< https://uswest.ensembl.org/Homo_sapiens/Variation/Sample?db=
core;r=17:39815097-39975098;v=1s8067378;vdb=variation;vf=88214830#373531_tablePanel >

```{r}
mxl<- read.csv("373531-SampleGenotypes-Homo_sapiens_Variation_Sample_rs8067378.csv")
head(mxl)
```

```{r}
table(mxl$Genotype..forward.strand.)
```

```{r}
table(mxl$Genotype..forward.strand.)/nrow(mxl)*100
```

Now we will look at another population GBR.

```{r}
gbr<-read.csv("373522-SampleGenotypes-Homo_sapiens_Variation_Sample_rs8067378.csv")
```

Now find proportion of G|G

```{r}
round(table(gbr$Genotype..forward.strand.)/nrow(gbr)*100,2)
```

This varient associated with childhood asthma is more frequent in GBR population.
